about: Triage table for the catalog: one entry per skill under variants/. An agent reads read_when/skip_when and opens only what the task needs. validate_skills.py fails when a variants/ directory has no entry, an entry has no file, or README.md does not name the id.

units.read_when: every session — the one output register: how the visible answer reads, which acceptable solution to prefer
units.skip_when: never (it is the only register shipped); do not load a second register beside it

units.read_when: every session in one of the owner's repositories: what must exist and be verified before 'done' (verification ladder, commit before session end, 'Not verifiable here', UI behaviour contract)
units.skip_when: never; but it is not a writing register and not stack guidance

units.read_when: the repository's real build entry point is CMake with find_package(Qt6 ...) or qt_add_executable
units.skip_when: no Qt 6 CMake target (plain CMake/C++, Lua or script modding, web, Python)
